method: Actual current CLI add/get in isolated child processes; Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo sampled every 50 ms; inputs generated before measurement in 1 MiB blocks; temporary database and inputs deleted after test. Random bytes from os.urandom; actual Python sources bundled as deterministic tar for compressible-code case.
criterion: For 1 GB compared to 100 MB: peak WS and commit growth <= 50,000,000 bytes. Integrity requires exact output byte count and SHA-256.
